note: Both sets capture the same core facts (finished floor and grade level elevations, section scales, revision history), but A binds the grade-level elevations to the two sections where the markers actually appear (C1 West Module, A1 East Module) and adds the East Module scale claim. B instead attaches a single Grade Level claim to a "Reference datum" condition that the page never states, and omits the per-section grade-level readings. Both sets repeat the same elevations and scales several times under slightly different names.
remarks: Both sets state Grade Level 0'-0" three times and Finished Floor 2'-9 1/2" twice with varying unit labels (ft-in / feet-inches / none), and Section C1 scale three times (as Section C1, SECTION - WEST MODULE, and a 'ratio' variant) — the same facts under two or three names. The elevation markers appear in both the C1 and A1 section views, so per-section binding (as in A) is the faithful reading. Revision-table and title-block entries are administrative and were treated as neutral.
